title: From Acting to Learning: Experience Selection toward Continually Learning Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.27159v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Successful agent interactions provide training data, but success alone does not determine which records a student should learn from. We examine experience selection for a 4B language agent as a component of continual agent learning. Nine selectors are compared across two fixed experience pools, eight initialization seeds, and two sampling seeds, yielding 288 trained students. Each student is evaluated on 128 development task groups with a common executor. With equal global selection freedom, 256 distinct contents, and 768 training presentations, optimizer-aware gradient selection reaches 81.45\% and 73.19\% success in the two pools. Its gains over global random selection are 8.25 and 5.96 percentage points; gains over global high-NLL selection are 4.10 and 4.05 points. All eight initialization-level contrasts are positive against both baselines in each pool. Relaxing coverage constraints improves gradient selection but reduces random-sel

translated_title: 从行动到学习：面向持续学习智能体的经验选择
translated_abstract: 成功的智能体交互能够提供训练数据，但仅凭成功本身并不能决定学生（模型）应当从哪些记录中学习。我们将经验选择作为持续智能体学习的一个组成部分，针对一个 4B 参数的语言智能体展开研究。在两个固定经验池、八个初始化种子和两个采样种子的条件下，比较了九种选择器，共训练出 288 个学生模型。每个学生模型均通过统一的执行器在 128 个开发任务组上进行评估。在全局选择自由度相同、包含 256 个不同内容、共 768 次训练呈现的设置下，优化器感知的梯度选择方法在两个经验池中分别取得了 81.45% 和 73.19% 的成功率；相比全局随机选择，其提升分别为 8.25 和 5.96 个百分点；相比全局高 NLL 选择，其提升分别为 4.10 和 4.05 个百分点。在两个经验池中，全部八组初始化层面的对比均优于两个基线。放宽覆盖约束可以进一步提升梯度选择的效果，但会降低随机选择的表现（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文将经验选择作为持续学习智能体的关键组成部分，通过大规模对照实验证明，优化器感知的梯度选择方法在学生智能体任务成功率上显著优于全局随机选择和高 NLL 选择两种基线。
en_tdlr: This paper treats experience selection as a key component of continual agent learning and shows, through large-scale controlled experiments, that optimizer-aware gradient selection significantly outperforms global random and high-NLL selection baselines in student agent success rates.
